title: The only MacBook I’d gladly pay full price for is $300 off for Black Friday
content:
Macworld

MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display

View Deal

In my opinion, the MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is Apple’s best-ever MacBook and one of the best laptops ever made. However, the fact is that it’s also Apple’s most expensive laptop ever, a considerable $400 more than the mini-LED MacBook Pro. So, if you really want the best, it’d be nice if you can get a deal on it, and fortunately, there is one. Walmart’s Black Friday sale has the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display for $2,649, a savings of $250, and the 16-inch M5 Pro model for $3,099, a $300 savings (also available at Amazon).

Whichever size you choose, the PROLED XDR MacBook Pro is an ideal laptop for content professionals who do critical work on visuals. Its tandem OLED display provides the best color reproduction ever seen on a MacBook. It produces vivid colors, the deepest blacks, and extraordinary contrast and brightness. It’s so gorgeous, you’ll want to touch it, so go right ahead–this also happens to be Apple’s first-ever touchscreen Mac. You can tap, drag, select, and do gesture input on the touchscreen, just as you would with the trackpad. Once you use one, you won’t want to go back to a normal LCD screen.

These configurations come with an M5 Pro chip with 24GB of RAM, so it can handle your toughest processing jobs with ease. Plus, Apple even made this laptop lighter and a tad smaller than the previous MacBook Pro, so it’s less of a burden when you’re on the go. Plus, it’s got a Dynamic Island so you can follow live activities without needing to dig out your iPhone.

So go grab a new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display because you’re going to love it. Oh, and also because it’s on sale.
